caption: The drawing depicts a single object centered on a lightly yellowed, beige background. The object resembles a mitten-like or pouch-like form with two pointed, rounded extensions at the bottom. The main body of the object is filled with brownish, tan, and ochre hues. It has decorative patterns, including a geometric triangle-based border at the top and bottom, filled with alternating light and dark shades. The central area features a repeated motif of diagonal and horizontal lines creating symmetrical, leaf- or branch-like shapes. The lower extensions are filled partly with a paler yellow shade, bordered by darker, stitched-like lines. The drawing has a muted, naturalistic palette dominated by browns, tans, and subdued yellows and is rendered with lightly textured strokes. The object occupies most of the space within a rectangular inner border, which itself sits on a wider, similarly colored background with visible staining and aging effects.
title: Birch Bark Cape Collar
